claim: lookupRestaurantRole (apps/api-gateway/src/organizations/organizations.service.ts) returns role null with readError set, and does not read users, when the user_restaurant_access read errors. It reads the person's one access row whatever its is_active, with is_active, valid_from and valid_until. A row that exists decides alone: it gives its role only while isLiveMembership (common/tenant/live-membership.ts) holds and the role is non-empty, and users is not read. Only a read that found no row falls back to users.role when users.restaurant_id is this house. MembersService.assertMembership (apps/api-gateway/src/restaurants/members.service.ts) applies the same three rules, answering 403 on an access-read error and on a row that is not live, and keeps users.role || "staff" for no row at all. ProcurementService.assertApprovalAllowed reads the role through OrganizationsService.readRestaurantRole and turns RestaurantRoleUnreadableError into a 500 before parkOrderAwaitingApproval and recordApprovalRefusal. (ADR 0248, founder 2026-10-01: "Next PR: error means no role (Recommended)", "Strict for the order seal (Recommended)", "Fold into #561 (Recommended)", "Close both in #561".) At 2019ae7f6 both helpers read only active rows, ignored the window and fell back to users.role on an access-read error, and the seal read the role non-strictly. Pinned by role-read-error-means-no-role.spec.ts (17 [REVERT-FAILS] cases), order-approval-gate.spec.ts (4) and members.service.spec.ts (5), all red on 2019ae7f6.
